leaves.name: scholzeDeRhamAlg
leaves.doc: Scholze, p-adic Hodge theory for rigid-analytic varieties, Forum Math. Pi 1 (2013), Cor. 1.8 with Thms 9.1 and 9.3 and the corrigendum Forum Math. Pi 4 (2016) e6, applied as in diophantine_zq.tex lem:de-rham-descent L10953-10965 (step C3): for F finite over Q_p and X proper smooth over F, H^i_et(X_Fbar, Q_p) is de Rham and the Hodge filtration of D_dR has its jumps in [0, i] (the filtered comparison D_dR = H^i_dR(X) with Fil^0 H^i_dR = H^i_dR, Fil^{i+1} = 0). Lean form: H^i = Q_p (x)_{Z_p} Scheme.EllAdicCohomology (X x_F Spec Fbar) p i (Mathlib's pro-etale l-adic cohomology), sigma acting by transport along 1 x Spec(sigma^-1) (DeRhamScholze.galHX = t10-etale's galH); D_dR = (B_dR (x) W)^{G_F}, Fil^j = D_dR meet (t^j B_dR^+ (x) W). Consequence, not printed form: the print is for rigid-analytic varieties (not in Mathlib); dictionary steps analytification + Thms 9.1/9.3 (in the manuscript), Fbar vs C_p and pro-etale vs etale (on-the-spot, derham-scholze report section 3)
leaves.flag: pending review: new leaf (derham-scholze), consequence of Scholze 2013 Cor. 1.8 + Thms 9.1, 9.3 (the manuscript's own citation for step C3) over Mathlib's pro-etale l-adic cohomology; journal numbering of Scholze UNVERIFIED here (arXiv v2 and journal locators read by the locator audit, locators.md R10)
leaves.source: Scholze, Forum Math. Pi 1 (2013), Cor. 1.8, Thms 9.1, 9.3, corrigendum Forum Math. Pi 4 (2016) e6 (manuscript lem:de-rham-descent, L10953-10965): H^i_et(X_Fbar, Q_p) de Rham with Hodge jumps in [0, i], over Mathlib's EllAdicCohomology (derham-scholze)

leaves.name: deRhamHodgeTate01
leaves.doc: GLUE (on-the-spot; the manuscript's 'Consequently the Tate module has weights 0,0,-1,-1', lem:de-rham-descent L10995-10996): a finite-dimensional de Rham representation of G_F whose Hodge filtration has its jumps in [0, 1] is Hodge-Tate with weights in {0, 1}: C_p (x) W = C_p^a + C_p(-1)^b, G_F-equivariantly (Fontaine: de Rham implies Hodge-Tate with gr D_dR = D_HT). Proof sketch in docs/research/derham-scholze.md section 4
